question: Do other sources in the same panel and candidate construction identify a tie rule worth deploying on an omitted source?
scope: Retrospective on previously examined guarded forest outcomes. No resplitting or new test data.
strata: Analyze the two candidate constructions and two panels separately. Average draws within an original fold, then folds within a source. Hold out one entire source for all policy choices and comparisons.
objective: Mean effective compression minus lambda times outer breach frequency, equally weighted over training sources. Computational costs are not in this objective.
baseline: Always use a single point margin on the whole slate with the same guard. This does not require constructing votes.
comparisons: For each penalty report all fixed policies, the held-source winner from the four-rule tier library, and the held-source winner when the cheaper baseline is available in the library. Resolve training objective ties by first member in the fixed preference order. Compare on the same held source; retain zero-opportunity sources. Report U, breach, net value, paired differences, number of positive/tied/negative source differences, and all source-level choices. No uncertainty interval from fixed-selection held-out scores.
